## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together, discussing their classmates and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). During afternoon lessons, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in fury. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and she furiously refuses Gilbert's apology after school.
>

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) forces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as punishment for being late, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) packs up her things and refuses to return to school. Upon Mrs. Rachel Lynde's advice, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) allows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to stay home and study on her own, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) continues to hold a fierce grudge against [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while imagining a tragic future without [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), with Matthew's help, to let her go to a [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert and driving with Diana's cousins, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed only to leap on top of Diana's sleeping [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who becomes furious.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatizes Elaine with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby, but the flat leaks and she is forced to cling to a bridge pile while the boat sinks. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in his dory, but when he asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly refuses him. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the dangerous mishap, though [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) privately encourages her not to give up all her romance.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing an advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agree to support Anne's joining the class, which delights [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). The Queen's class is formed, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels saddened by Diana's absence and finds herself in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) while privately regretting her past grudge against him.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offering pragmatic advice before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md). At the hotel, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suffers from severe stage fright upon facing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience, she finds her determination, delivers a successful recitation, gets encored, and is warmly praised by the guests.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares to leave for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), sharing an emotional moment with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) before departing [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). After arriving in town, she starts her classes alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) peers and copes with initial homesickness in her boarding house, where visits from [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and Ruby reveal that an Avery scholarship is available.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adjusts to life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), forming a close group of ambitious friends and continuing her friendly academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She frequently visits [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and stays focused on her studies. As examinations approach in the spring, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her philosophical mindset with her classmates while they anxiously prepare for tests and discuss commencement attire.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns she must give up reading and sewing to save her eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives up her scholarship to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to stay home, teach at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) surrenders the position for her, and save the farm. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) finally reconcile their rivalry, becoming close friends as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces her new future.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss their different philosophies on teaching and discipline the evening before the school term begins. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to avoid corporal punishment. The next morning, a nervous [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her first day of teaching with encouragement and ginger tea from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue their fundraising canvass, encountering various quirky neighbors including the neat freak Mrs. Theodore White and the overjoyed [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), who donates handsomely following the birth of his son. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a subscription, but he flatly refuses.
>

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she is writing and studying, and the two talk about their teaching experiences and future aspirations. After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the dying Mrs. Keith and her twins, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take the children in.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the village hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). After the painter finishes, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers that the hall has been painted a glaring blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint order numbers. The news spreads, devastating the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but the villagers rally behind the young people while blaming the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) for the mistake.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) stealing plum jam and lectures him, before learning with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins will remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until fall. Later at an [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent-medicine company for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit Judson to persuade him otherwise, but he smoothly refuses to change his mind.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) while his grandmother is away, having tea with him and listening to his imaginative thoughts. Later at home, she puts a jealous [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and reassures him of her affection. Afterwards, she meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and reflects on how mature he has become.
>

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bedtime-talks with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about trying to be good, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) near the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) to discuss their village improvement society's progress and upcoming plans. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and chats with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her busy schedule for the next day.
>

> Uncle Abe's weather prediction unexpectedly comes true when a destructive hail and lightning storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), severely damaging crops, trees, and buildings. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and the twins weather the fury of the tempest at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before assessing the community-wide destruction, which includes the loss of Mr. Harrison's parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her impending departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in the orchard before walking to the Post Office. On her way home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her on the bridge and tries to express his deeper feelings, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cuts the moment short. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts and talks with young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) about her plans and growing up.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they are presented with gifts before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves for college. The next evening, after feeling discouraged by well-meaning neighbors, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk through the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), where they find a wild apple tree and enjoy a peaceful stroll together.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) on a rainy morning after saying emotional goodbyes to her family and friends. She travels by boat and train alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie, eventually arriving in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) where [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) greets her and takes her to their new boarding house.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen class wins the annual Arts Rush under Gilbert's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly befriends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them to her broad social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of comforting letters from home, including updates from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk through the park and into town. As they linger, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss life, sorrrow, and happiness while taking in the sunset. On their way home, the group discovers a charming old house called Patty's Place on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) instantly feels connected to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After completing their first-term examinations at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays while [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) heads to [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is joyfully welcomed by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and the twins, later helping little [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) resolve his guilt over wanting to say a bad word. Over [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives letters from Miss Lavendar, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), and later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> During her second term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) contends with unwanted romantic attentions from [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), whom she turns down. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a proposal from her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) to rent a house together for the next school year, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) on a search that ends with a sign on Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) about a baking powder story contest, only to be horrified when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reveals she edited and submitted Anne's story 'Averil's Atonement,' winning the prize. Although distraught over her work being turned into an advertisement, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is somewhat comforted when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) offers a practical perspective on the matter.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P4](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0004), [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays, which are dampened by severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and worries about her college finances. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) engages [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in amusing chatter until Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail. Among the letters, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that Miss Josephine Barry has died and left her a thousand dollars in her will.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

_Sources: [v3 ch.Anne-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat inside Patty's Place before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) steps outside into the orchard. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) joins her and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) heartbroken and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upset over the loss of their friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036)_

> While preparing for the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) seen frequently with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), feeling unusually off-kilter, and immediately notices [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the room with Christine.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their deep friendship. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) marries [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), after which [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, talking about their summer plans and how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is changing.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P16](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0016), [v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her stories, delighting her and the household. Later, while out on a walk with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns his family plans to visit Patty's Place on Saturday. However, Roy's mother and sisters arrive unexpectedly on Friday while the household is unprepared, leading to an awkward visit featuring rambunctious cats and a flattened chocolate cake.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022)_

> As examinations finish and graduation arrives, the girls at Patty's Place reflect on what they have learned from their college experience. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's flowers over Roy's. Later, after hearing a rumor of Gilbert's engagement to Christine, she breaks her pink heart chain in secret distress and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes a walk through the autumn woods to Hester Gray's garden, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts for the following afternoon. There, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) confesses his enduring love for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and asks her to marry him, clearing up past misunderstandings about [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) happily accepts, and they walk home together engaged.
>
